import itertools

mod = 998244353

def calculate_permutation_sum(N, M):
    # Initialize the sum of all values
    total_sum = 0

    # Generate the initial permutation
    initial_permutation = list(range(1, N + 1))

    # Generate all possible sequences of M swap operations
    for swaps in itertools.combinations(itertools.combinations(range(N), 2), M):
        # Apply the swaps to the initial permutation
        permutation = initial_permutation[:]
        for swap in swaps:
            i, j = swap
            permutation[i], permutation[j] = permutation[j], permutation[i]

        # Calculate the value of the permutation
        value = sum(abs(permutation[i] - permutation[i + 1]) for i in range(N - 1))

        # Add this value to the total sum
        total_sum = (total_sum + value) % mod

    # Return the total sum modulo 998244353
    return total_sum
